sections.changelog: v1.2.104: Plugin Directory search now lives in its own sidebar section, preloads popular plugins, supports grid/list views, uses plugin icons, and fills the available Studio height. Content Studio now filters duplicate default Pages/Posts from CPT lists, hides Advanced Themer/options-page field groups, supports in-place field editing, and uses stronger branded focus styles. CSS Studio returns to the slimmer MV panel sizing so the editor is visible again, Bricks media interception is broader for image/SVG/media/background controls, and Structure/Elements floating is less likely to conflict with hide settings.
